remarks:
Well-loved and cared-for ranch-style home on Jamestown’s west side, where quality construction and pride of ownership are evident inside and out. Conveniently located between downtown Jamestown and the Fairmount Avenue commercial corridor, with schools, parks, recreation, shopping and dining all close by. This move-in-ready home offers the ease of single-story living along with an open floor plan that works equally well for everyday living and entertaining.

The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, plenty of counter and workspace, stainless steel appliances and an easy flow into the main living areas. The adjoining living room features gorgeous matte-finished hardwood flooring, a large picture window providing plenty of natural light and a fireplace that adds warmth and character.

All three bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level and offer good closet storage. The updated full bath features a subway tile tub/shower surround, vanity with storage and marble top. First-floor laundry adds another level of convenience, while additional washer and dryer hookups remain in the basement should the next owner prefer to move the laundry downstairs.

The huge full basement provides excellent storage and plenty of potential for additional finished living space. A convenient 1/4 bath is already in place, making a future bathroom expansion that much easier.

Numerous improvements add to the home's appeal, including a newer roof, new electrical service and newer fenced yard. Mechanical updates include a high-efficiency furnace with Aprilaire, central air conditioning and tankless hot water.

Outside, the semi-private fenced rear yard provides plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors, while the covered rear deck creates a comfortable spot for morning coffee, summer meals or relaxing at the end of the day.

The home is fully applianced, including refrigerator, gas range, microwave, dishwasher, disposal, washer and dryer. With its desirable ranch layout, updated mechanicals, newer roof, fenced yard, attached garage and move-in condition, 15 Hilldale Avenue offers an appealing combination of comfort, convenience and easy living.
